title: Memorializing the unborn by lowering the United States flag to half-staff on the 22d day of January each year.
latestAction: Referred to the House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform.
policyArea: Civil Rights and Liberties, Minority Issues
summary: This resolution expresses support for recognizing a Day of Tears and lowering flags to half-staff to honor unborn lives lost to abortion.

actions.text: Referred to the House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform.
